scheme_name: Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors Registered with the Directorate of Fisheries to Purchase the Accessories Required for Fish Vending
other_conditions: The applicant must be a fish vendor registered with the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa.
The beneficiary can avail of the scheme only once every three years.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 50% (up to ₹10,000) for general category and 60% (up to ₹12,000) for SC/ST/Women on fish vending equipment, claimable once every three years.
